a.text: Heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (generate to 8, then take 4 each) will very likely leave us both with nothing. The reserve already holds exactly 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. I don't want to break our agreement behind your back, so I'm raising it openly. Are you willing to amend it? If not, I'll stick to the original plan and operate. Tell me your intended action and I'll be straight with you about mine.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. You didn't agree to amend the plan, so I'm keeping my word and operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
